messages:
Ava: quick design check pls — updated vectors preview + export flow in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/embeddings-export (see 'Preview -> Export' frames). focus: batch upload UX, column names in export, and rerank score display.

Lena: looked through. main nit: export CSV header names feel inconsistent with table labels. we use 'vector_id' in table but CSV shows 'id'. also should we include a 'source' column (batch file name) when exporting mixed uploads?

Diego: agreed re headers. also recommend adding a normalized score column (0-1) in export for easier downstream filtering. keep raw_score too for debug. spacing for score column — right-align numbers in table so decimals line up.

Morgan: accessibility nits: keyboard focus in preview modal currently traps on the canvas and skips the export button. need tabbable export action and visible focus ring. contrast on the score pill (green) is below WCAG for some color-blind combos.

Sam: copy suggestion: change action from 'Export' -> 'Export selection' when rows are selected, otherwise 'Export all results'. avoids accidental exports. also for the small confirmation dialog show estimated file size and row count.

Ava: good recs. on the 'source' column — we often get large batches from multiple files, so including 'batch_name' would help. Lena, can you propose exact header names?

Lena: proposal: CSV headers -> "vector_id","batch_name","text_snippet","raw_score","norm_score","model","embedding_dim". keep snake_case for downstream heatmaps.

Diego: looks good. one more: export should support both CSV and JSONL. JSONL for payloads with long text. include a sample preview in the export modal.

Morgan: for keyboard users, the export modal should support pressing Enter to confirm and Esc to cancel. add aria-live region that announces "Export job started" and later "Export complete — 3.2MB". design-bot: can we hook the success snackbar into screen readers?

design-bot: automated note: current analytics track export_start and export_complete events with properties { format, row_count, user_id }. recommend adding estimated_size and batch_id.

Sam: UX flow question — when a user exports thousands of rows do we stream download or enqueue server-side job with email/notification? preference: server job + progress UI + download link so client doesn't block. show sample status states: Queued -> Working -> Complete -> Failed (with retry).

Ava: agreed. show a progress list in the console: job name, started_at, completed_at, rows, file_size, link. also add a small 'Cancel' for queued/working.

Lena: mock copy for confirmation modal: "You're about to export 12,342 rows from 3 batches (estimated 4.1 MB). A file will be prepared and available in your Downloads when ready." smaller note: "Downloading large exports may take several minutes."

Diego: visual: add a small chevron to table rows to expand the text_snippet (like preview). keyboard: up/down to move selection and Enter to toggle expand. keep height stable to avoid layout shift.

Morgan: accessibility: expanded content should be role="region" with aria-labelledby pointing to the row header, and the expand button needs aria-expanded toggles. update color tokens for score pills and add text variant that shows score value for color-blind users.

Ava: final asks for this round: 1) update Figma with header name changes and export modal states, 2) add keyboard flow annotations, 3) Lena to draft confirmation copy, 4) Diego to spec CSV/JSONL example payloads. I'll schedule a quick follow-up review Wed 10am.

Lena: noted, will push copy later today.

Diego: I'll attach a tiny CSV sample in the thread — example header + one row:

```
vector_id,batch_name,text_snippet,raw_score,norm_score,model,embedding_dim
vec_0001,batch-apr-21,"How to bake sourdough at home",-2.341,0.81,open-embed-v1,1536
```

Sam: LGTM — main blocker is server-side job implementation but UX looks good. :thumbsup:

Morgan: thanks all. small follow-up: test with NVDA/VoiceOver and include keyboard-only video in the PR.

Ava: perfect — thank you! :party_parrot:
